methods: SHA-256 byte comparison within the supplied batch and against the live archive
PDF page count and embedded metadata comparison
Targeted text extraction plus OCR-aware review of scan-only pages
Rendered visual inspection of every short and medium record, all council-packet pages and targeted evidentiary pages in long audited reports
Cross-check against existing manifests and research indexes
Full page-by-page audit of 390 archive PDFs totaling 13,526 pages, including OCR on 2,615 scan-required pages
Rendered inspection of all 88 visually sparse pages and native-text inspection of three DOCX containers

Category 17-19 intake: all 240 supplied PDF pages rendered and reviewed, including 138 retained pages requiring image-based review; hashes, page counts and metadata were cross-checked before retention or suppression

Category 19 literature continuation: seven peer-reviewed PDFs totaling 74 pages were hash-checked, text-extracted and rendered page-by-page; article titles, publication dates, DOI identifiers and PDF metadata were cross-compared with the current and historical repository

decisions.name: 2015-2016_Wexford County Landfill_Leachate Request.pdf
decisions.reason: Exact SHA-256 match to the three-page source already linked in the event trace; the existing record is reused.

decisions.name: N3862_SAR_20171106 (1).pdf
decisions.reason: Byte-identical to N3862_SAR_20171106.pdf. One cleanly named copy is retained and no duplicate label is propagated.

decisions.name: Seven retained records
decisions.reason: Each retained PDF has a distinct hash and materially distinct content or evidentiary role; related subjects were not treated as duplicates.

decisions.name: Flood Plain Management Study — Clam River
decisions.reason: Retained as historical watershed and flood-receptor context only; it is not characterized as PFAS source or migration proof.

decisions.name: Two Wexford County Landfill permit PDFs
decisions.reason: The construction permit and operating license exactly match records already in the archive and are reused without republishing.

decisions.name: 20250123_125751.pdf
decisions.reason: Rendered pages and extracted content establish that it is a byte-different scan of the same 1988 feasibility study. The clearer OCR-fixed copy is retained without a duplicate label.

decisions.name: ORIGINAL CEA Contract 2008-2010.doc
decisions.reason: Cadillac Education Association collective-bargaining agreement; excluded as unrelated to the WWTP, landfill, PFAS, groundwater or environmental compliance record.

decisions.name: Hydrogeologic Investigation — 1140 Plett Road
decisions.reason: Retained as a secondary synthesis and records-request plan. Its hypotheses and unresolved data gaps are not promoted to primary-source findings.

decisions.name: Cadillac council archive, 2008-2026
decisions.reason: Thirty-eight packets with distinct hashes and specific landfill, PFAS, cleanup-system, testing, funding, public-response or infrastructure evidence are retained. Other non-identical packets are classified as out of scope, incidental or materially overlapping; they are not mislabeled as duplicates.

decisions.name: July 20, 2026 council packet
decisions.reason: The archive copy is an exact SHA-256 match to the existing Council Packet 7-20-26 record, so the established source link is reused without publishing another copy.

decisions.name: October 2020 packet pair
decisions.reason: The October 5 and October 19, 2020 files are byte-identical and visually identical. The second copy is suppressed; neither packet adds material Cadillac environmental evidence to the curated library.

decisions.name: May 19 2025 City Council Meeting Minutes
decisions.reason: Retained as a distinct 38-page adopted-minutes package. Its SHA-256 hash, page sequence and rendered pages differ from the existing 92-page May 19 council packet; three budget-attachment pages share normalized text, but no page renders identically. All 38 pages were read, with OCR applied to the one sparse page and no manual-review failures.

decisions.name: September 8 2017 WWTP solids-analysis bench sheet photograph
decisions.reason: Retained once in its corrected upright orientation after page rendering and OCR. IMG_0033-cas.pdf is the same underlying photograph in a sideways container and is suppressed. The catalog describes only the visible solids-analysis sheet: its leachate column is blank, so filename references to gallons hauled or additional hidden sheets are not promoted as findings.

decisions.name: Category 17 SDS and chemical-product records
decisions.reason: Eighteen distinct safety-data records were retained after hash, page, metadata and rendered-content review. Fluoropolymer and fluoroelastomer records are described as product-level source-screening evidence, not as proof of facility use or PFAS discharge; proprietary and nonfluorinated products remain contextual records.

decisions.name: 01-15-2018 - c-scans-HIGH-CONTRAST.pdf
decisions.reason: Exact SHA-256 match to the 20-page record already cataloged in the industrial-pretreatment library. The established source is reused and no second copy is published.

decisions.name: 2019-11-06 Wexford County Board of Commissioners minutes
decisions.reason: The supplied file is a later OCR/searchable derivative of the same four-page minutes already preserved as the canonical original. Metadata records the 2026 OCR conversion, and reference manifests confirm the same-content relationship. The derivative is suppressed and its duplicate label is not propagated.

decisions.name: Public-body and technical-context records
decisions.reason: The 2025 MSP OMA report, 2022 Wexford County board packet and 2016 North Carolina dioxane report have distinct hashes and roles. The OMA report is procedural evidence rather than an adjudicated environmental finding; the board packet preserves landfill groundwater-monitoring budget context; the dioxane report is external methodology, not Cadillac data.

decisions.name: Seven wastewater-indicator and emerging-contaminant research papers
decisions.reason: All seven papers have distinct SHA-256 hashes, DOI identifiers, page sequences and subject matter, with no matching DOI or binary in the current or historical repository. All 74 pages contain intact embedded text and were visually reviewed. They are retained as external analytical and source-identification context; none is characterized as Cadillac-specific sampling or proof of a local source.
